page.layout: One page of verse, one column; running head at top; a catchword-like fragment "Tali" at lower right; a few small marks in the right margin (no printed notes).

main_text.p:
Decreta nunc refigis? an dispar tibi,
Dubiúsque mox promissa praestas, mox datam
Fallis fidem? Dedisti Isacum qui mea
Charum senectutis foret solatium:
Nunc longiores abnuens vita moras,
Migrare terris ecce vix natum iubes,
Et immiserabilem trucidari fero
Mucrone patris, & ignium rogis
Crudelium tibi cremari victimam.
Sed quo, precor, me mentis impetus rapiti
O parce, Rector alme Caelitum, misér
Mortalis incolens luteas domos, tui
Omitto scestigare consilij abditos
Sensus: nec ultra limites fixos ruens,
Parebo semper quidquid imperaveris.
main_text.head: SATHANAS.

p.i:
Quid? Ergo prima vicit ille fortior
Tentationis impetus sanos, licet
Vix inveniri possit vlla durior?
Nam, quaeso, secum si Deus pugnantia
Edicat, aut sententias mutet suas,
Quis crediderit Deum esse? Quis tali Deo
Fidat. Sed altera nunc aggrediar illum via.

main_text.head: ABRAHAMVS.

p.i:
O! Sana me fortasse ludunt somnia,
Fictáque Daemon obiiciens imagines,
Et monstra menti horrenda me vult impium
Contaminare cade nati dexteram.
Nonne Deus offerri vetat sibi hostias

page.notes: Printed text is a verse poem in italic with long s rendered as s; some words uncertain (e.g. "scestigare", "misér", "Sana", "Tali" is a catchword-like fragment at the foot right). Marks in the right margin are ink specks, not notes.
